title: Wayfare Pass Black-Rider All Access Discount — Desk Guidance
content:
# Black-rider All Access discount — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule the desk applies

On a move up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual, the Black-rider All Access discount counts the member's completed Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV trips dropped off in the last three months: 4 percent at 3 or more, 2 percent at 1 or 2, nothing at none. It is taken off the All Access upgrade charge as that percentage of the All Access Annual membership fee of 249.00; the percentage is of the 249.00 fee itself, the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Trips counted

Trips in the member's trip records in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) whose ride option is Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV, whose status is completed and whose drop-off falls in the last three months. Both ride options count toward one total.

## Points of judgement

| Completed Wayfare Black and Black SUV trips, last three months | Discount |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 4 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 2 percent |
| none | nothing |

- One Wayfare Black trip and two Wayfare Black SUV trips: 3, so 4 percent, 9.96 taken off.
- Two Wayfare Black trips: 2 percent, 4.98 taken off.
- A Wayfare Comfort trip does not count.
